issues.description: The solution repository's Person entity declares the id field as Integer but its getId()/setId() methods use Long, and the PersonRepository uses JpaRepository<Person, Long>. The template Person entity (and repository) use Long for the id. This creates a type mismatch between the entity field, its accessors, and the repository generic type. Students following the template or the repository signatures will be confused and will encounter compile-time or runtime JPA mapping errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the id type consistent across all artifacts. Preferably change the field declaration in solution/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java to 'private Long id;' and ensure getId()/setId() use Long, matching the PersonRepository's JpaRepository<Person, Long> and the template. Alternatively, change repository generics and all accessors to Integer—whichever keeps a single consistent id type across entity, accessors, and repository.
